blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. The primary outcome was accuracy; secondary outcomes included calibration, discrimination, accuracy of answers with probability >=0.90 and language differences. Results: In RheumaMIR, Jev's accuracy was 93.0% in Spanish and 91.9% in English, below GPT-6 Sol (99.4%; Holm-adjusted P<=0.005); GPT-6 Luna reached 97.7%, Clef 91.9-93.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%, without detectable language differences. Jev's answers with probability >=0.90 (76-77% of answers) were 98.5% correct. In RheumBench, accuracy was lower: GPT-6 Sol 76.9%, GPT-6 Luna 63.5%, Clef 59.6%, Jev 50.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4% (each System One model below GPT-6 Sol, Holm-adjusted P<=0.045; chance 9.6%). Jev became overconfident (mean probability 0.659; over/underconfidence index +0.159), and its answers with probability >=0.90 (25% of cases) were 84.6% correct, against 95.5% for GPT-6 Luna (42%). Laya performed near chance in both benchmarks. Conclusion: The best-performing System One models were highly accurate on examination questions but less accurate on diagnostic vignettes, remaining below GPT-6 Sol. Jev's high-confidence predictions were less reliable on vignettes, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation and calibration.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have been evaluated extensively in rheumatology, on tasks ranging from examination questions and differential diagnosis to information extraction and education [ 1 , 2 ] . In the RheumaMIR study [ 3 ] , GPT-4 correctly answered 93.7% of the rheumatology questions from the Spanish access examination to specialised medical training. In RheumBench, a specialist-validated benchmark of diagnostic and management cases, the best of ten systems ranked the correct diagnosis first in 57.1% of 70 diagnostic cases answered in free text [ 4 ] . However, because LLMs generate their answers token by token, they have limitations that matter in clinical practice. They can produce plausible but incorrect content [ 5 ] . Their text outputs may need parsing or normalisation before automated use, which can introduce formatting and extraction errors [ 6 , 7 ] . The numerical confidence they report tends to be overestimated and discriminates poorly between correct and incorrect answers [ 8 , 7 ] ; for instance, in RheumBench, the confidence stated by every system exceeded its diagnostic accuracy [ 4 ] . Longer sequential outputs also increase generation latency and inference cost, which is relevant for deployment at health-system scale [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在风湿学中得到了广泛的评价,涉及的任务从检查问题和差别诊断到信息提取和教育[1,2]. 在RheumaMIR研究[3]中,GPT-4正确回答了93.7%的风湿病学问题,从西班牙的准入检查到专门的医学培训. 在Rheum Bench这个经专家验证的诊断和管理案例基准中,在70个诊断案例中,以免费文本回答的57.1%将正确诊断排在第一。 然而,由于LLMS以象征性方式产生答案,它们在临床实践中具有重要的局限性。 它们可以产生合理但不正确的内容 [5]. 它们的文本输出在自动化使用前可能需要解析或正常化,这可以引入格式化和提取错误[6,7]. 他们报告的数字信任往往被高估,对正确和不正确的答案加以歧视[8、7];例如,在Rheum Bench, 每个系统所声明的信任都超过了其诊断准确性[4]。 较长的顺序产出还增加了产生延迟性和推论成本,这与卫生系统规模的部署有关。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, many clinical applications of artificial intelligence (AI) need a choice among predefined alternatives rather than free text, such as deciding whether a patient meets trial eligibility criteria or whether an article meets review inclusion criteria [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Much of rheumatology decision-making likewise consists of structured judgements based on unstructured information. Classification criteria, for example, are weighted sums of explicitly defined items [ 14 ] , and routine work includes triaging referrals, checking requirements before biologic therapy and coding diagnoses. Each of these judgements could be posed as a question with predefined answers. The probability assigned to each answer could then be used to select which answers a rheumatologist reviews. Such tasks require an answer restricted to the predefined options, with a probability that reflects how likely it is to be correct.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,人工智能(AI)的许多临床应用需要在预先定义的替代品中做出选择,而不是自由文本,例如决定患者是否符合试诊资格标准,或者某篇文章是否符合审查的列入标准[10,11,12,13]. 风湿病学决策大多同样包括基于非结构信息的结构化判断。 例如,分类标准是明确界定的项目的加权总和[14],日常工作包括分类转诊、生物治疗前的检查要求和编码诊断。 每一项判决都可以作为一个问题提出,并有预先界定的答案。 然后,每个答案的概率可用于选择哪个答案是风湿病学家的评论。 此类任务需要一个仅限于预定义选项的答案,其概率可以反映其是否正确.

blocks.en: Decision and System One models are a recently introduced class of AI models designed for this kind of decision (Figure 1 ) [ 15 , 16 ] . They receive a “state” describing a case, along with typed questions whose possible answers are defined in advance, and return a probability for each allowed answer. The output is machine-readable and cannot fall outside the options provided, but it gives no rationale that a clinician could inspect.
blocks.zh: 决定和制度 一种模型是最近推出的为这种决定设计的AI模型类别(图1)[15,16]. 他们收到一个“状态”来描述一个案例,以及一些打字的问题,这些问题可能的答复是事先确定的,并返回每个允许的答复的概率。 产出是机器可读的,不能超出所提供的选择范围,但它没有说明临床医生可以检查的理由。

blocks.en: Figure 1: How a large language model (LLM) and a System One model process the same clinical note. Diagram drafted with large language model assistance; content verified by the authors.
blocks.zh: 图1:大语言模型(LLM)和System One模型如何处理同样的临床注释. 在大型语言模型的协助下起草图表;内容由作者核实。

blocks.en: Within one month of Jev’s release, the first popularised model of this class, more than 100 decision models had been listed on independent leaderboards, including solutions from OpenAI, Microsoft, AWS and Cloudflare [ 17 ] . Open-source alternatives include Laya [ 18 ] and Clef [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: Jev发布后一个月内, 这个班级的首个大众化模型, 100多个决策模型被列在独立领导板上, 开源替代品包括Laya [18] 和Clef [19].

blocks.en: Evidence on System One models in medicine is scarce. In a benchmark of Jev on four medical datasets, its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier reasoning LLM, GPT-6 Sol, on questions about research abstracts but lower on examination questions and complex diagnostic cases, and its better-calibrated probabilities did not yield more answers that could be accepted at a given accuracy [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于系统的证据 医学的一个模型是稀缺的。 在Jev关于四个医学数据集的基准中,它的准确性与前沿推理LLM,GPT-6 Sol关于研究摘要问题的基准相似,但在检查问题和复杂诊断案例方面则较低,而且其更好的校准概率并没有产生更多可以以一定准确性接受的答案[20].

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no System One model has been evaluated in rheumatology or in a language other than English. Notably, Jev’s primary training language is English [ 16 ] . Likewise, the application of these models to complex diagnostic cases, where the correct diagnosis must be chosen among many plausible alternatives and may be absent from the options offered has not been studied.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有一个系统一模型在风湿学或英语以外的语言中受到评价。 值得注意的是,Jev的主要培训语言是英语[16]。 同样,还没有研究将这些模型应用于复杂的诊断病例,因为在许多可能的选择中必须选择正确的诊断,并且可能没有选择所提供的选择。

blocks.en: We therefore evaluated four System One models (Jev, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and Laya) and GPT-6 Luna through OpenAI’s Decisions API on RheumaMIR and RheumBench. We assessed how often each model selected the official answer, whether its probabilities identified answers more likely to be correct, and whether accuracy differed between Spanish and English.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们通过OpenAI关于RheumaMIR和Rheum Bench的决定API,评价了四个系统一模型(Jev、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1和Laya)和GPT-6 Luna。 我们评估了每个模型选择正式答案的频率,其概率是否确定答案更可能正确,以及西班牙语和英语的准确性是否不同。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Study design
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究设计

blocks.en: This was a cross-sectional benchmark study of nine model conditions on RheumaMIR and RheumBench. No participants were recruited and no identifiable patient data were used. The study is reported following the TRIPOD-LLM guideline [ 21 ] . In line with recommendations for LLM-based rheumatology research [ 22 ] , we report model versions, openness, access route and evaluation dates, together with the code, requests and responses (see Data availability). For brevity, GPT-6 Luna is grouped with the System One models in the tables and comparisons.
blocks.zh: 这是对RheumaMIR和Rheum Bench的9个模型条件的跨部门基准研究。 没有征聘参加者,也没有使用可识别的病人数据。 研究报告遵循了《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》-LLM准则[21]。 根据基于LLM的风湿学研究[22]的建议,我们报告模型版本、开放性、访问路线和评价日期以及代码、请求和答复(见数据可用性)。 为了简洁起见,GPT-6 Luna在表格和比较中与系统一模型进行分组。

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集

blocks.en: • RheumaMIR [ 3 ] . The MIR is the annual national examination for access to specialised medical training in Spain, with single-best-answer questions (four to five options) and definitive answer keys published by the Ministry of Health. RheumaMIR contains 145 rheumatology-related records from the 2009–2010 to 2022–2023 examinations; image-dependent questions were excluded when the dataset was built. We added 30 text-based rheumatology-related questions from the three subsequent examinations (2023–2024 to 2025–2026), selected by a rheumatologist, with keys checked against the definitive answer tables of the Ministry. After exclusion of two duplicate records and of one question invalidated by the Ministry, 172 questions were analysed. Each question was evaluated in Spanish and in English. The English versions had been translated automatically. All English translations were then reviewed against the Spanish with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), which was also used to correct language errors in the Spanish text. Further details can be found in Supplementary Section S1.1 and Table S1 . • RheumBench [ 4 ] . RheumBench is a specialist-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs in rheumatology. Its 70 diagnostic cases comprise 60 published case reports of rare rheumatic diseases and clinically important differential diagnoses, and 10 de-identified cases from the University Hospital Hamburg; 42 represent inflammatory rheumatic diseases and 28 non-inflammatory differential diagnoses. In the original benchmark, systems proposed diagnoses in free text that were scored against case-specific rubrics. For this study, each vignette was paired with 5 to 18 candidate diagnoses in alphabetical order proposed by systems investigated in the RheumBench study. In 52 cases one candidate names the reference diagnosis; in the other 18, none does. Only the option naming the reference diagnosis was scored as correct. In 12 cases the option that words the reference diagnosis differently was matched by hand. More details can be found in Supplementary Section S1.2 .

blocks.en: 2.3 Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 模型

blocks.en: The evaluated models, how they were accessed and the considerations relevant to the interpretation of their results are summarised in Supplementary Table S2 . Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and Laya) and GPT-6 Luna, accessed through OpenAI’s Decisions API, were evaluated. GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning was the primary comparator; GPT-6 Sol without reasoning and two generative models run locally (Gemma 4 12B and Qwen3-8B) were secondary comparators. No model was fine-tuned.
blocks.zh: 补充表S2概述了评价模型、如何获得模型以及与解释模型结果有关的考虑因素。 四个系统 其中一个模型(Jev 1.13、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1和Laya)和GPT-6 Luna,通过OpenAI的决定API访问,得到了评价。 具有中等推理的GPT-6 Sol是主要的参照物;没有推理的GPT-6 Sol和两个本地运行的基因模型(Gemma 4 12B和Qune3-8B)是次要的参照物. 没有模型经过微调。

blocks.en: System One models and GPT-6 Luna return a probability for each option as a direct output, without generating text. The generative models were asked in the prompt to write a probability for each option; these stated probabilities are self-reported estimates.
blocks.zh: 系统 一个模型和GPT-6 Luna返回每个选项作为直接输出的概率,而不生成文本. 要求基因模型迅速为每个选项写出概率;这些说明的概率是自报的估计数.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation procedure
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价程序

blocks.en: In RheumaMIR, all models were provided with the question stem, the response options in their original numbering and order, and a neutral instruction in the language of the item (e.g., “ Which option is the correct answer to this question? ”). System One models received the stem and the options as a single-choice question, and generative models received them in one user message with a request for the answer number and a probability for each option (Supplementary Section S2 ). No system prompt, example, or reference answer was used, and prompts were not optimised. Requests were sent between 5 and 10 October 2026. The answer selected by the model was scored as returned, even when another option had a higher probability. The local generative models, whose server could not enforce an output format, were asked to answer only with a JSON object, and the first JSON object in each response was scored.
blocks.zh: 在瑞玛 MIR,所有模型都得到了问题底盘,原编号和顺序的响应选项,以及项目语言的中性指示(例如“哪个选项是这个问题的正确答案?” )。 系统 一个模型作为单选问题接收了树干和选项,基因模型在一个用户信息中接收了它们,请求给出答案号码和每个选项的概率(补充部分S2. 没有使用系统即时、示例或参考答案,也没有优化提示。 请求是在2026年10月5日至10日期间发出的。 模型选择的答案被评为返回,即使另一个选项的概率更高. 本地的基因模型,其服务器无法执行输出格式,被要求只用一个JSON对象来回答,每个响应中的第一个JSON对象都得分.

blocks.en: In RheumBench, every model received the instruction “ Which option is the most likely diagnosis? ”, the vignette verbatim and the numbered candidate diagnoses, in the same request formats as in RheumaMIR; generative models received the vignette under the label “ Case: ”. In the primary option set, the candidate diagnoses were given as listed, and all 70 cases were sent. In a secondary option set, “ None of the above ” was added as the last option of every case, so that it was the correct option in the 18 cases without the reference diagnosis and all 70 cases had a correct option.
blocks.zh: 在Rheum Bench案中,每个模型都收到“最有可能的诊断是哪种选择?” 指示,Vignette逐字记录和编号的候选诊断与RheumaMIR中的请求格式相同;基因模型在“案例:......”的标签下收到Vignette。 在主要选项集中,按清单列出候选人的诊断结果,所有70个病例均已发送。 在一套次要选项中,“上述任何一种”作为每个病例的最后选项被添加,因此,在没有参考诊断的情况下,它是18个病例的正确选项,所有70个病例都有正确的选项。

blocks.en: Every condition was run three times with identical requests in each dataset and option set. The first run was the primary analysis; later runs assessed repeatability. Repeated runs and language versions were paired observations of the same items, not independent samples.
blocks.zh: 每个条件运行三次,每个数据集和选项集都有相同的请求. 第一次是初步分析;后来是评估的可重复性。 重复的运行和语言版本是对相同物品的对映观测,而不是独立的样本.

blocks.en: 2.5 Outcomes and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 2.5 结果和统计分析

blocks.en: The question or case was the unit of analysis. The primary outcome was accuracy, the proportion of items for which the selected option matched the reference answer, with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Paired comparisons used the exact McNemar test, with CIs for differences from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of items that kept paired outputs together. Holm adjustment covered three families comprising ten System One versus GPT-6 Sol medium comparisons across both RheumaMIR languages, five System One language comparisons, and five System One versus GPT-6 Sol medium comparisons in RheumBench (Supplementary Section S3 and Table S3 ). Secondary comparators were described without significance tests. Accuracy expected from random guessing was the mean reciprocal of the number of options. Agreement between languages was summarised as the percentage of questions with the same selected option and Cohen’s kappa. For Laya, which used different checkpoints for English and Spanish items (Supplementary Table S2 ), comparisons between languages also reflect the checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 问题或案件是分析的单位。 主要结果是准确性,即选定选项与参考答案相符的项目比例,威尔逊95%的置信间隔。 Paired比较使用了精确的McNemar测试,其中CI用于与2 000个使输出组合在一起的靴子套件的区别。 Holm调整涵盖三个家庭,包括十个系统一对GPT-6 Sol在RheumaMIR两种语言的中度比较,五个系统一语言比较,以及五个系统一对GPT-6 Sol在Rheum Bench的中度比较(补充部分S3和表S3)。 二级比较者的描述没有进行意义测试。 从随机猜测中预计准确性是选择数的对等平均值。 与科恩的kappa一样, 对于对英文和西班牙文物品使用不同检查站的Laya(补充表S2),各语文之间的比较也反映了检查站的情况。

blocks.en: Probability analyses used the probability of the selected option (selected-answer probability); System One probabilities, including those returned by the Decisions API, were analysed as returned and stated probabilities were rescaled to sum to 1 over the offered options, keeping equal stated probabilities tied (Supplementary Section S2 ). Calibration was summarised by the over/underconfidence index, with reliability diagrams (Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S1 ) and with the expected calibration error (ECE; ten equal-width bins closed on the right; Supplementary Section S4 ), reported descriptively without CIs. Discrimination between correct and incorrect answers was summarised by the correctness AUROC, with bootstrap CIs (Supplementary Table S4 ). To assess a possible review strategy, answers with a selected-answer probability of at least 0.90 were retained and the rest deferred; we report the number and proportion of answers retained (coverage) and the accuracy of the retained answers.
blocks.zh: 概率分析使用了选定选项的概率(选定答案概率); 对一种可能性,包括由 " 决定API " 退还的概率,进行了分析,确定为退回的概率,并将所申报的概率调整为1比所提议备选办法的总和,同时保持相等的申报概率(补充S2节)。 校准由过度/信心不足指数总结,并附有可靠性图(图2和补充图S1)和预期校准误差(欧洲经委会;右侧关闭10个等宽箱;补充部分S4),报告为描述性无CIs。 正确和不正确的答案之间的区别由正确性AUROC总结而来,并附有 " 线索 " (补充表S4)。 为了评估可能的审查战略,保留了至少0.90的选定答案概率,其余的答复被推迟;我们报告保留答复的数目和比例(涵盖范围)以及保留答复的准确性。

blocks.en: In both benchmarks, repeatability was summarised as the percentage of items with the same answer in all three runs and the range of single-run accuracy (Supplementary Table S5 ). Sensitivity analyses recomputed the ECE with five equal-width bins, scored the highest-probability option instead of the returned answer and, for Laya, restricted RheumBench to the vignettes it read in full (Supplementary Section S4 ). Latency and cost were described in Supplementary Table S6 .
blocks.zh: 在这两项基准中,可重复性被概括为在所有三个运行中答案相同的项目的百分比和单运行准确度的范围(补充表S5)。 敏感性分析使欧洲经委会重现了5个等宽箱,得分最高的概率选项,而不是返回的答案,对Laya来说,将Rheum Bench限制在读完的阴道上(补充部分S4)。 紧急性和费用在补充表S6中作了说明。

blocks.en: In RheumBench, accuracy, probability measures and retained answers were analysed in the 52 cases whose reference diagnosis was among the options. The other 18 were analysed as an exploratory forced-choice test, counting the forced answers that the 0.90 threshold would have accepted. In the None of the above option set, we report how often None of the above was selected in the 18 and in the 52 cases, and accuracy over the 70 cases (Supplementary Table S7 ).
blocks.zh: 在Rheum Bench中,对52个案例的准确性、概率计量和保留答案进行了分析,其中参考诊断是其中的选项。 其他18个被分析为一种探索性的强制选择测试,计算0.90阈值会接受的强制答案. 在上述所有选项中,我们报告在18个和52个选项中经常没有选择上述选项,70个选项的准确性(补充表S7)。

blocks.en: To describe the most confident errors, we listed the ten RheumaMIR questions answered incorrectly with the highest selected-answer probabilities by Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 or GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning (Supplementary Table S8 ).
blocks.zh: 为了描述最有自信的错误,我们列出了十个RheumaMIR问题,它们与Jev,GPT-6 Luna,Clef,Microsoft-Decision-1或GPT-6 Sol等选择的概率最高的回答错误(补充表S8).

blocks.en: Analyses used Python 3.13 with a fixed random seed.
blocks.zh: 分析使用 Python 3.13 并带有固定的随机种子.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 RheumaMIR: accuracy and language
blocks.zh: 3.1 RheumaMIR:准确性和语言

blocks.en: Of 172 questions per language, Jev answered 160 (93.0%) correctly in Spanish and 158 (91.9%) in English, versus 171 (99.4%) for GPT-6 Sol in both languages, with and without reasoning (Table 1 ). Paired values below follow this language order. All differences refer to GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning, and all P values are Holm-adjusted (Supplementary Table S3 ). Jev was 6.4 and 7.6 percentage points less accurate (P=0.005 and P=0.001), and GPT-6 Sol answered all but one of Jev’s errors correctly in each language. GPT-6 Sol’s only discordance with the answer key, a 2011–2012 hip-fracture prevention question, was shared by Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1, Qwen3-8B and, in English, Laya (Supplementary Sections S1.1 and S3 ). GPT-6 Luna answered 168 (97.7%) correctly in both languages ( − - 1.7 percentage points; P=0.500).
blocks.zh: 在每种语言的172个问题中,Jev以西班牙语正确回答160个(93.0%),英语正确回答158个(91.9%),而两种语言的GPT-6 Sol为171个(99.4%),无论有无推理(表1)。 下面的标值遵循这个语言顺序. 所有差异都指中推理的GPT-6 Sol,所有P值都是Holm调整的(补充表S3. Jev的准确度为6.4和7.6个百分点(P=0.005和P=0.001),GPT-6 Sol在每种语言中只正确回答Jev的所有错误之一. GPT-6 Sol唯一与答案密钥的不和,一个2011-2012年的臀部骨折预防问题,被Jev,GPT-6 Luna,Microsoft-Decision-1,Qune3-8B和Laya(补充部分S1.1和S3)分享. GPT-6 Luna在两种语言中都正确回答168(97.7%)(−-1.7个百分点;P=0.500).

blocks.en: Table 1: Accuracy by model (primary outcome).
blocks.zh: 表1:按模式分列的准确性(主要结果)。

blocks.en: English − - Spanish, pp (95% CI)
blocks.zh: 英语 - 西班牙语,pp (95% CI)

blocks.en: Clef answered 158 (91.9%) and 160 (93.0%) correctly ( − - 7.6 and − - 6.4 percentage points; P=0.005 and P=0.010) and Microsoft-Decision-1 151 (87.8%) and 148 (86.0%) ( − - 11.6 and − - 13.4 percentage points; both P<0.001). Laya performed near chance (22.1% and 25.0%, against 23.2% expected). Gemma 4 12B (80.8% and 82.6%) and Qwen3-8B (64.0% and 68.0%) were less accurate than every remote System One model. No System One model showed a statistically detectable difference in accuracy between languages (all Holm-adjusted P=1.000), although the CIs did not exclude differences of several percentage points (Jev, − - 1.2; 95% CI − - 5.2 to 2.3). Jev selected the same option in both languages for 94.2% of questions (Cohen’s kappa 0.92), GPT-6 Luna for 97.7% (0.97), Clef for 91.9% (0.89) and Microsoft-Decision-1 for 89.5% (0.86), against 34.9% for Laya. Accuracy in the 30 new questions was within 4 percentage points of that in the historical questions for Jev, GPT-6 Luna and Clef, and 3–9 points lower for Microsoft-Decision-1.
blocks.zh: Clef对158(91.9%)和160(93.0%)的答复正确(--7.6和-6.4个百分点;P=0.005和P=0.010)和Microsoft-Decision-1 151(87.8%)和148(86.0%)(--11.6和-13.4个百分点;均为P<0.001)。 Laya几乎有机会(22.1%和25.0%,预计为23.2%)。 Gemma 4 12B(80.8%和82.6%)和Qune3-8B(64.0%和68.0%)的准确度低于每个远程系统一号模型. 无系统 一种模型显示,在统计学上,各语言之间的准确性有可察觉的差别(所有Holm调整后P=1.000),尽管CI没有排除几个百分点的差异(Jev,−-1.2;95%CI−-5.2至2.3)。 Jev对94.2%的问题(Cohen的kapa 0.92)、GPT-6 Luna对97.7%(0.97)、Clef对91.9%(0.89)和Microsoft-Decision-1对89.5%(0.86)选择了同样的选择,对Laya选择34.9%。 30个新问题中的准确性在Jev、GPT-6 Luna和Clef的历史问题中的4个百分点以内,而Microsoft-Decision-1则低3-9个百分点。

blocks.en: 3.2 RheumaMIR: probabilities and retained answers
blocks.zh: 3.2 RheumaMIR:概率和保留答案

blocks.en: Jev’s probabilities matched its accuracy (over/underconfidence index − - 0.015 and 0.000), had low calibration error (ECE 0.030 in Spanish and 0.010 in English; Table 2 ; Figure 2 A) and separated correct from incorrect answers well (correctness AUROC 0.904 and 0.916; Supplementary Table S4 ). At the 0.90 threshold, Jev retained 130 (75.6%) and 132 (76.7%) of the 172 answers, with 98.5% accuracy in both languages (95% CI 94.6–99.6). GPT-6 Luna’s mean selected-answer probability was below observed accuracy (0.928 and 0.914 versus 97.7%; index − - 0.049 and − - 0.062), and the threshold retained 135 (78.5%) and 127 (73.8%) answers with 99.3% and 100.0% accuracy.
blocks.zh: Jev的概率与其准确性(过度/不信任指数− - - 0.015和0.000)相符,校准差低(ECE 0.030, 英文为0.010;表2;图2A),并将正确性与错误答案区分开来(正确性AUROC 0.904和0.916;补充表S4)。 在0.90阈值下,Jev保留了172个答案中的130个(75.6%)和132个(76.7%),两种语言的准确度分别为98.5%(95% CI 94.6-99.6). GPT-6 Luna的平均选择答案概率低于观测到的准确度(0.928和0.914比97.7%;指数−-0.049和−0.062),阈值保留了135(78.5%)和127(73.8%)的答案,精确度分别为99.3%和100.0%。

blocks.zh: 表2: 概率质量和答案保留在至少0.90的选定答案概率.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Reliability diagrams of the System One models and GPT-6 Sol (run 1). (A) RheumaMIR, Spanish (top row) and English (bottom row), 172 questions per language. (B) RheumBench, listed option set, 52 cases whose reference diagnosis is among the options. Each point is one of ten equal-width bins (closed on the right) of the selected-answer probability, plotted against the accuracy of those answers; point area is proportional to the number of answers; points below the diagonal indicate overconfidence; panel titles give the ECE. GPT-6 Sol is shown with medium and with no reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图2:系统一模型和GPT-6 Sol的可靠性图(运行1). (A) RheumaMIR,西班牙语(上行)和英语(下行),每种语言172题. (B) Rheum Bench, 所列选项集,52个案例的参考诊断是选项之一。 每个点是选定答案概率的10个等宽箱(右侧关闭)之一,对照这些答案的准确性绘制;点区与答案数成比例;对角线下点表示过度自信;面板标题给予欧洲经委会。 GPT-6 Sol以介质显示,没有推理.

blocks.en: Clef also had low calibration error (ECE 0.035 and 0.034) with lower observed AUROC values than Jev (AUROC 0.851 and 0.789), and Microsoft-Decision-1 was overconfident (mean selected-answer probability 0.950 and 0.934, against 87.8% and 86.0% accuracy; index +0.072 and +0.073); their retained answers were 96.4–97.7% and 91.3–95.7% correct, respectively. The ten questions with the highest-probability errors (0.967–0.999) were all answered incorrectly by Microsoft-Decision-1 in Spanish, mostly on the choice of investigation or treatment; one, a negatively worded question on temporal arteritis, was also a high-confidence error of Jev and Clef in both languages (Supplementary Table S8 ).
blocks.zh: Clef的校准误差也较低(ECE 0.035和0.034),观测到的AUROC值低于Jev(AUROC 0.851和0.789),Microsoft-Decision-1则过于自信(平均选答概率为0.950和0.934,准确率分别为87.8%和86.0%;指数+0.072和+0.073);其保留的答案分别为96.4-97.7%和91.3-95.7%。 10个问题最有可能发生错误(0.967–0.999),但都由Microsoft-Decision-1在西班牙语中错误地回答,大多是关于调查或治疗的选择;一个问题,一个关于时间性关节炎的负面措辞问题,也是Jev和Clef在两种语言中的高度自信错误(补充表S8).

blocks.en: GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning retained 170 (98.8%) answers in each language, all correct, whereas Laya and the local generative models showed poor discrimination (AUROC 0.52–0.61; Supplementary Table S4 and Figure S1 ).
blocks.zh: 中等推理的GPT-6 Sol在每种语言中保留了170个(98.8%)的答案,所有答案都正确,而Laya和当地的基因模型则显示出较差的歧视(AUROC 0.52-0.61;补充表S4和图S1)。

blocks.en: 3.3 RheumBench: accuracy
blocks.zh: 3.3 Rheum Bench:准确性

blocks.en: Of 52 cases, GPT-6 Sol answered 40 (76.9%) correctly with medium reasoning and 39 (75.0%) without, against 9.6% expected from random guessing (Table 1 ). GPT-6 Luna answered 33 (63.5%), Clef 31 (59.6%), Jev 26 (50.0%) and Microsoft-Decision-1 21 (40.4%), 13.5 to 36.5 percentage points below GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning (Holm-adjusted P ≤ \leq 0.045; Supplementary Table S3 ), although the differences for GPT-6 Luna and Clef rested on few discordant cases. GPT-6 Luna, Clef and Jev were not compared with each other, so their ranking was not established. Laya answered 5 (9.6%) correctly, Gemma 4 12B 21 (40.4%) and Qwen3-8B 16 (30.8%).
blocks.zh: 在52起案件中,GPT-6 Sol以中度推理正确回答40(76.9%),没有回答39(75.0%),而随机猜测预计为9.6%(表1)。 GPT-6 Luna回答33(63.5%),Clef 31(59.6%),Jev 26(50.0%)和Microsoft-Decision-1 21(40.4%),比GPT-6 Sol低13.5-36.5个百分点,有中度推理(Holm调整的P ≤\leq 0.045;补充表S3),尽管GPT-6 Luna和Clef的差异只停留在少数不和谐的病例上. GPT-6 Luna,克莱夫和Jev没有互相比较,因此他们的排名没有确定. Laya答对5(9.6%),Gemma4 12B 21(40.4%)和Qune3-8B 16(30.8%)。

blocks.en: 3.4 RheumBench: probabilities and retained answers
blocks.zh: 3.4 Rheum Bench:概率和保留答案

blocks.en: Every model except GPT-6 Sol without reasoning was overconfident (over/underconfidence index +0.028 to +0.620; Table 2 ). Clef had the lowest ten-bin ECE (0.066) and, among the System One models, the index closest to zero (+0.028). GPT-6 Luna had the highest observed AUROC among the System One models (0.876), close to GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning (0.872) (Figure 2 B; Supplementary Table S4 ). Jev was overconfident (mean selected-answer probability 0.659 against 50.0% accuracy; index +0.159; ECE 0.174) and discriminated less clearly (AUROC 0.737). Microsoft-Decision-1 (mean 0.730 against 40.4% accuracy; +0.327) and Laya (0.716 against 9.6%; +0.620) were more overconfident, and the stated probabilities of the local generative models discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.570–0.620; Supplementary Figure S1 ).
blocks.zh: 除GPT-6 Sol外,没有推理的每个模型都是过度自信(过度/不信任指数+0.028到+0.620;表2 ). 克莱夫的指数最低的是欧洲经委会的十宾(0.066),在系统一模型中,指数最接近零(+0.028)。 GPT-6 Luna在System One模型中观测到的AUROC最高(0.876),接近GPT-6 Sol,有中度推理(0.872)(图2 B;补充表S4 ). Jev过于自信(平均选定回答概率为0.659,准确度为50.0%;指数+0.159;欧洲经委会0.174),歧视程度较低(AUROC 0.737)。 Microsoft-Decision-1(平均0.730对40.4%的准确性;+0.327)和Laya(0.716对9.6%;+0.620)的过度自信程度较高,当地基因模型所宣称的概率受到不良歧视(AUROC 0.570-0.620;补充图S1)。

blocks.en: At the 0.90 threshold, GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning retained 23 (44.2%) of the 52 answers, all correct, and GPT-6 Luna retained 22 (42.3%) with 95.5% accuracy. Jev retained 13 (25.0%) with 84.6% accuracy, Microsoft-Decision-1 15 (28.8%) with 73.3%, and Clef 5 (9.6%), all correct (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 在0.90阈值下,中推理的GPT-6 Sol保留了52个答案中的23个(44.2%),全部正确,GPT-6 Luna保留了22个(42.3%),精确度为95.5%. Jev保留了13(25.0%),准确率为84.6%,Microsoft-Decision-1 15(28.8%),为73.3%,Clef 5(9.6%),均正确(表2)。

blocks.en: 3.5 RheumBench: reference diagnosis not among the options
blocks.zh: 3.5 Rheum Bench:非备选方案中的参考诊断

blocks.en: In the 18 cases where no option named the reference diagnosis, every selected answer was wrong, yet the 0.90 threshold would still have accepted at least one of them for six of the nine conditions (Supplementary Table S7 ). When None of the above was added, only GPT-6 Luna (4 of 18), Microsoft-Decision-1 (3) and Laya (9, but also 32 of the 52 cases with a correct option) selected it in these cases.
blocks.zh: 在18个没有指定参考诊断的案例中,每一个选定的答案都是错误的,然而,0.90的门槛值在9个条件中的6个条件中仍将至少接受其中1个(补充表S7)。 当没有添加上述内容时,只有GPT-6 Luna(18中的4个),Microsoft-Decision-1(3)和Laya(9个,但也有32个有正确选择的52个案例)选择了这些案例.

blocks.en: 3.6 Repeatability, latency, cost and sensitivity analyses
blocks.zh: 3.6 可重复性、耐久性、成本和敏感性分析

blocks.en: In both benchmarks, GPT-6 Luna, Clef and Laya returned the same answer in all three runs for every item, and GPT-6 Luna and Clef also returned identical probabilities. Jev changed its answer in five RheumaMIR question-language pairs and two of the 52 analysed RheumBench cases, and Microsoft-Decision-1 in six and three. GPT-6 Sol changed no RheumaMIR answer with medium reasoning and one without, but changed its answer in six RheumBench cases with medium reasoning and four without, although its accuracy with medium reasoning was the same in all three runs. The local generative models were less repeatable (Supplementary Table S5 ). Median latency was 0.21–0.48 s for the remote System One models, against 1.36–6.53 s for GPT-6 Sol and 3.1–39.9 s for the local generative models, and costs per 1,000 items were US$0.007–0.138, against US$0.96–5.54 (Supplementary Table S6 ). Scoring the highest-probability option changed accuracy by at most one item for every condition except Qwen3-8B in RheumaMIR, and Laya remained near chance on the RheumBench vignettes it read in full (Supplementary Section S4 ).
blocks.zh: 在这两个基准中,GPT-6 Luna,Clef和Laya在每件物品的所有三个运行中都返回了相同的答案,GPT-6 Luna和Clef也返回了相同的概率. Jev在5个RheumaMIR问题语言对和52个分析的Rheum Bench案件中的2个以及6个和3个的Microsoft-Decision-1中改变了答案. GPT-6 Sol没有用中推理修改RheumaMIR的答案,一个没有,而是用中推理修改了6个Rheum Bench的答案,还有4个没有,虽然它用中推理的准确性在所有3个运行中都是一样的. 当地基因模型的重复性较低(补充表S5)。 远程系统一号模型的中位延迟为0.21-0.48秒,而GPT-6 Sol的中位延迟为1.36-6.53秒,当地基因模型的中位延迟为3.1-39.9秒,每1 000件物品的成本为0.007-0.138美元,而补充表S6为0.96-5.54美元。 除了RheumaMIR的Qune3-8B外,对最高概率选项进行校准,每个条件的准确性最多改变一个项目,而Laya在全读的Rheum Bench vignettes上仍然几乎有机会(补充部分S4)。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Across RheumaMIR and RheumBench, the System One models performed very differently. On MIR questions, Jev 1.13 answered more than nine of ten questions correctly and 98.5% of the three quarters of its answers given a probability of at least 0.90 were correct; GPT-6 Luna came within two points of GPT-6 Sol; Clef was about as accurate as Jev, but its probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers less clearly; and Microsoft-Decision-1 was less accurate and overconfident. On RheumBench vignettes, accuracy was lower for every model, the remote System One models remained 13–37 points below GPT-6 Sol, and Jev’s probabilities became overconfident. Laya performed at or near chance in both benchmarks, and no language difference was detected in RheumaMIR.
blocks.zh: 穿越瑞玛 MIR和Rheum Bench,系统一号模型的表现非常不同. 关于MIR问题,Jev 1.13正确回答了10个问题中的9个以上,四分之三的回答中98.5%给出了至少0.90的概率是正确的;GPT-6 Luna来到了GPT-6 Sol的两个点之内;克莱夫大约和Jev一样准确,但其概率与不正确的答案区分得不太清楚;而Microsoft-Decision-1的准确度和过度自信度较低. 在Rheum Bench vignettes上,每个模型的精度都较低,远程System One模型仍然低于GPT-6 Sol的13–37分,而Jev的概率变得过于自信. 在这两种基准中,Laya都是偶然或几乎偶然的,在RheumaMIR中没有发现语言差异。

blocks.en: 4.1 Accuracy and the reference standard
blocks.zh: 4.1 准确性和参考标准

blocks.en: Jev’s accuracy on RheumaMIR was higher than in the only previous evaluation of the model in medicine (74.8% on MetaMedQA examination questions and 59.8–61.8% on complex diagnostic cases) [ 20 ] , whereas on RheumBench (50.0%) it was closer to that reported for complex diagnostic cases.
blocks.zh: Jev对Rheuma的准确性 MIR高于此前唯一一次医学模型评价(关于MetaMedQA检查问题为74.8%,关于复杂诊断病例为59.8-61.8%)[20],而关于Rheum Bench(50.0%),它更接近关于复杂诊断病例的报告。

blocks.en: The gap with the frontier model remained in both benchmarks. In RheumaMIR, GPT-6 Sol answered almost all of Jev’s errors correctly, and its only error, shared by Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1, Qwen3-8B and, in English, Laya, was a disagreement with a key set more than a decade ago that may no longer reflect current practice. Part of the residual error of the best models may therefore lie in the reference standard. The near-perfect performance of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna also means that this dataset no longer discriminates between frontier models.
blocks.zh: 与前沿模式的差距仍然存在于两个基准中。 在RheumaMIR中,GPT-6 Sol对Jev几乎所有错误的回答都是正确的,它唯一的错误由Jev,GPT-6 Luna,Microsoft-Decision-1,Qune3-8B以及英语的Laya所分享,与十多年前的一套可能不再反映当前实践的密钥有分歧. 因此,最佳模型的剩余错误部分可能在于参考标准。 GPT-6 Sol和GPT-6 Luna的近完美性能也意味着这个数据集不再区分边疆模型.

blocks.en: RheumBench did discriminate between them. Its vignettes describe rare diseases and their mimics and come with up to 18 candidate diagnoses, many of them close alternatives. These accuracies are not directly comparable with those of the original free-text RheumBench evaluation, because here the candidate list narrowed the search, the 18 cases without the reference diagnosis were analysed separately and the models were different. Over all 70 cases, GPT-6 Sol answered 57.1% correctly with the listed options, the same proportion as the best system in the original free-text evaluation, so its higher accuracy in the 52 cases mainly reflects the exclusion of the 18 cases without the reference diagnosis. With None of the above added, it answered 61.4% correctly (Supplementary Table S7 ), but the gain came from the 52 cases with a correct listed option (43 against 40 correct), because GPT-6 Sol never selected None of the above.
blocks.zh: Rheum Bench确实区别对待他们。 它的vignette描述罕见的疾病及其模仿,并产生多达18个候选诊断,其中许多是近距离替代. 这些速率与原始的自由文本Rheum Bench评价并不直接可比,因为这里的候选名单缩小了搜索范围,没有参考诊断的18个病例被单独分析,模型不同. 在所有70个病例中,GPT-6 Sol对列出的选项给出了57.1%的正确回答,与原始自由文本评价中最好的系统的比例相同,因此在52个病例中其更高的准确度主要反映了没有参考诊断的18个病例被排除在外. 由于没有增加上述内容,它正确答复了61.4%(补充表S7),但收益来自有正确上列选项的52个案例(43个对40个对),因为GPT-6 Sol从未选择过以上任何一个.

blocks.en: GPT-6 Luna came within two points of GPT-6 Sol on examination questions and had the highest point accuracy among the System One models on RheumBench, suggesting that typed answers need not entail a large loss of accuracy; whether this reflects the model, its training or the interface cannot be determined from a black-box comparison.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Luna在考试问题上出现在GPT-6 Sol的两个点之内,在Rheum Bench上的System One模型中拥有最高的点精确度,说明打出的答案不需要引起很大的准确性损失;这是否反映了模型,其训练或界面无法通过黑盒比较来确定.

blocks.en: Clef and Microsoft-Decision-1 show that the typed interface does not by itself determine accuracy. Clef matched Jev’s accuracy in RheumaMIR but failed largely on different questions (Supplementary Section S3 ), whereas Microsoft-Decision-1 was less accurate than Jev in both benchmarks and, on RheumBench, no more accurate than a 12-billion-parameter generative model run on a laptop.
blocks.zh: Clef和Microsoft-Decision-1显示,打字界面本身并不能决定准确性. Clef在RheumaMIR中与Jev的准确性相匹配,但在不同的问题上(补充部分S3)大都失败了,而Microsoft-Decision-1在两个基准中都不如Jev准确,在Rheum Bench中,其精确度不超过一台笔记本电脑上运行的120亿参数的基因模型。

blocks.en: 4.2 Value of the probabilities
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 概率值

blocks.en: The feature that distinguishes System One models is the probability attached to each answer. Jev’s probabilities on examination questions were close to observed frequencies and ranked its answers well. In a deferral workflow [ 23 ] , the 0.90 threshold would have left about a quarter of the questions for a clinician to review, with an error rate of 1.5% among accepted answers. However, clinical thresholds must be chosen and validated for each task, and they must also be set for each model. For instance, at the same threshold, Microsoft-Decision-1’s accepted answers contained more errors than Clef’s.
blocks.zh: 区分System One模型的特征是每个答案所附带的概率. Jev在检查问题的概率接近观测频率, 在延期工作流程[23]中,0.90阈值将留下约四分之一的问题,供临床医生审查,在接受的答复中误差率为1.5%。 然而,必须选择和验证每项任务的临床阈值,还必须为每个模型设定这些阈值。 例如,在同一阈值上,Microsoft-Decision-1接受的答案包含比克莱夫更多的错误.

blocks.en: Our RheumBench analysis showed that observed calibration differed across tasks. On diagnostic vignettes, Jev’s probabilities were overconfident and its accepted answers less accurate; GPT-6 Luna’s probabilities, which had been lower than its accuracy on examination questions, had the highest observed correctness AUROC among the System One conditions; and Clef had the lowest observed ECE but was rarely confident enough to reach the threshold. Calibration measured on one task therefore cannot be assumed to transfer to another, even within a specialty, although estimates based on 52 cases are imprecise.
blocks.zh: 我们的Rheum Bench分析显示,观察到的校准因任务而异。 在诊断阴道方面,Jev的概率过高,接受的答案不太准确;GPT-6 Luna的概率低于其在考试问题上的准确性,在系统一条件下观测到的AUROC的正确性最高;Clef观察到的ECE最低,但很少有信心达到临界值。 因此,对一项任务进行的校准不能被假定为转让给另一项任务,即使在专业范围内也是如此,尽管根据52个案例所作的估计并不准确。

blocks.en: The value of a native probability was clearest in the comparison with the local generative models, whose stated probabilities discriminated poorly between their correct and incorrect answers in both benchmarks, in agreement with reports that confidence verbalised by LLMs is a poor guide to correctness [ 8 ] . Against GPT-6 Sol, in contrast, calibration gave the System One models no practical advantage, as in the previous benchmark [ 20 ] . All the frontier model’s answers with a stated probability of at least 0.90 were correct, and they covered almost all examination questions and 44% of the RheumBench cases.
blocks.zh: 与当地基因模型相比,本土概率的价值最为明显,而当地基因模型在两个基准中都表明的概率在正确和不正确答案之间差别不大,这与LLMs口头表达的信心是正确性的一个差劲指南的报告是一致的。 相对GPT-6 Sol而言,校准则使System One模型没有实际优势,如上一个基准[20]. 所有前沿模型的回答都是正确的,至少有0.90的概率,它们涵盖了几乎所有的检查问题和44%的Rheum Bench案件。

blocks.en: Probabilities over the listed options do not explicitly represent the possibility that the correct answer is absent. When the reference diagnosis was not among the candidates, the 0.90 threshold would still have accepted a forced answer for six of the nine conditions, and only GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1 and Laya in run 1 selected None of the above in those cases. In clinical tasks, the answer options must therefore be designed and validated as carefully as the thresholds, for example with an explicit “not documented” or “other” answer whose use is evaluated.
blocks.zh: 对所列备选办法的概率并不明确表明没有正确答案的可能性。 当参考诊断不在候选者中时,0.90阈值仍会接受9个条件中6个条件的强制回答,只有GPT-6 Luna,Microsoft-Decision-1和Laya在跑1中选择了上述情况中无一例外. 因此,在临床任务中,答案选项必须像阈值一样仔细设计和验证,例如,用一个明确的“无记录”或“其他”答案来评估其用途。

blocks.en: 4.3 Language, repeatability and deployment
blocks.zh: 4.3 语言、可重复性和部署

blocks.en: We found no evidence that Spanish reduced accuracy in RheumaMIR. Jev was not fully deterministic, and Microsoft-Decision-1 changed answers between runs, whereas GPT-6 Luna and Clef returned identical answers and probabilities in every run. GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning was not fully repeatable either. It changed 6 of the 52 RheumBench answers, more than any System One model, although its accuracy did not change. Jev’s latency was 4–16 times lower than that of GPT-6 Sol and its cost 50–180 times lower, and the other remote System One models were also faster and cheaper than GPT-6 Sol, differences that would matter if every note or referral in a health system were processed [ 24 ] . Finally, although open models keep patient data within the institution, the local generative models were less accurate, slower and less stable than Jev.
blocks.zh: 我们没有发现任何证据证明西班牙语在RheumaMIR中的精度下降. Jev没有完全确定性,微软-决定1在运行间改变了答案,而GPT-6 Luna和Clef在每次运行中都返回了相同的答案和概率. 具有中度推理的GPT-6 Sol也不能完全重复。 它改变了52个Rheum Bench答案中的6个,比任何System One模型都要多,尽管它的准确性没有改变. Jev的耐久性比GPT-6 Sol低4~16倍,成本也低50~180倍,而其他的远程系统一号型号也比GPT-6 Sol快,更便宜,如果一个医疗系统中的每个音符或转诊都得到处理,这些差异会很重要[24]. 最后,虽然开放模型将患者数据保存在机构内部,但当地的基因模型比Jev更准确,更慢,稳定性更差.

blocks.en: 4.4 Implications
blocks.zh: 4.4 影响

blocks.en: Examination questions and vignettes with candidate diagnoses are not the intended tasks of System One models, and these results do not show that any of them can classify patients, triage referrals or extract disease activity from notes. They show that the best of them have enough knowledge of the specialty, in Spanish and English, for such applications to be worth testing, and that their probabilities could help decide which answers a rheumatologist reviews.
blocks.zh: 检查问题和带有考生诊断的vigette不是System One模型的预定任务,这些结果没有显示其中任何一种可以对病人进行分类,分诊或从注释中提取疾病活动. 它们表明,其中最优秀的人有足够的西班牙语和英语的专长知识,因此这些应用值得测试,它们的概率可以帮助决定哪个答案是风湿病学家的评论.

blocks.en: Decision and System One models could support rheumatologists in the repeated, clearly defined judgements of routine care. Because these models choose among answers rather than generate them, their natural diagnostic role may be to check candidate diagnoses proposed by clinicians or generative models. They could also act as the decision layer of agentic AI systems, in which a language model decides at each step what should happen next and acts through tools such as the electronic health record or clinical calculators [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 决定和制度 一种模式可以支持风湿病学家对常规护理的反复、明确界定的判断。 因为这些模型选择答案而不是生成答案,其自然诊断作用可能是检查临床医生或基因模型提出的候选诊断. 它们也可以充当代理AI系统的决策层,其中语言模型在每一步骤决定下一步会发生什么,并通过电子健康记录或临床计算器等工具采取行动[25].

blocks.en: These uses need their own validation. RheumBench showed that, when the correct option was missing, the models rarely recognised it. Future studies should use real clinical text from local records in the local language, judgements decomposed into atomic questions, clinician-adjudicated references, answer options that allow for missing information, thresholds chosen on separate data for each model and task, and evaluation of the complete model-clinician workflow, to establish whether such workflows reduce workload without increasing errors.
blocks.zh: 这些用途需要自己的验证. Rheum Bench显示,当正确的选项缺失时,模型很少认出它. 未来的研究应该使用当地语言记录中真实的临床文本,判断分解为原子问题,临床判断参考,允许缺失信息的答案选项,为每个模型和任务分别选择的阈值,以及对完整的模型-临床工作流程的评价,以确定这些工作流程是否在不增加错误的情况下减少工作量.

blocks.en: 4.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 限制

blocks.en: First, neither benchmark represents routine clinical care. Examination questions are written to be unambiguous and always contain the answer, image-dependent questions were excluded, and the RheumBench candidate lists narrow the diagnostic search. Second, the samples were small. Third, training-data contamination cannot be excluded, because the MIR questions are public and 60 of the 70 RheumBench vignettes are published case reports. Fourth, neither language version reproduces the examination wording exactly. The English items were machine translations revised with a language model, and the same model was used to correct spelling, accent, punctuation and transcription errors in the Spanish text. Finally, some endpoints were in public beta or alpha, no analysis plan was registered, and remote services may change without notice; the results describe the versions available between 5 and 10 October 2026.
blocks.zh: 首先,两个基准都不是常规临床护理。 考试题写得毫不含糊,始终包含答案,视影像为依托的问题被排除在外,Rheum Bench的候选人名单缩小了诊断搜索的范围. 第二,样品很小。 第三,不能排除培训数据污染,因为MIR问题是公开的,70个Rheum Bench vignettes中有60个是公布的案例报告。 第四,两种语文文本都完全照搬考试的措辞。 英文项目是用一种语言模型修改的机器翻译,同样的模型用于更正西班牙文本中的拼写、口音、标注和抄写错误。 最后,一些端点在公共β或α中,没有注册分析计划,远程服务可能不经通知而改变;结果描述了2026年10月5日至10日之间可用的版本.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: On rheumatology examination questions in Spanish and English, Jev 1.13 answered more than nine questions in ten correctly; its probabilities identified a large subset of answers containing few errors, and its answers were fast and inexpensive. On diagnostic case vignettes with up to 18 candidate diagnoses, accuracy was lower for every model, Jev’s probabilities were overconfident, and all System One models remained below GPT-6 Sol. Microsoft-Decision-1 was less accurate and overconfident in both benchmarks, and the locally run System One model Laya performed at or near chance. Results obtained with one System One model or on one task therefore cannot be generalised to others. These findings support evaluating System One models, with deferral of uncertain answers to the rheumatologist and answer options that allow for missing information, on structured decisions such as applying classification criteria, triaging referrals and extracting information from clinical notes, using real clinical text before any use in patient care.
blocks.zh: 关于西班牙语和英语的风湿病检查问题,Jev 1.13正确回答了十分之九以上的问题;它的概率确定了一个包含少数错误的庞大的子集答案,它的答案是快速和廉价的. 在诊断性病例中,最多有18个候选人诊断,每个模型的准确性都较低,Jev的概率过高,所有System One模型都仍然低于GPT-6 Sol。 Microsoft-Decision-1在两个基准中都不太准确和过度自信,本地运行的System One模型Laya在偶然或近乎偶然的情况下进行。 因此,一个系统模式或一项任务所取得的成果不能归纳为其他任务。 这些调查结果支持评价第一系统模型,推迟对风湿病学家的不确定答案,以及允许缺失信息的答案选择,涉及结构化决定,如应用分类标准、分门别类的转诊和从临床说明中提取信息,在病人护理中使用真正的临床文本。

blocks.en: S1.1 RheumaMIR
blocks.zh: S1.1 RheumaMIR (英语).

blocks.en: Source. RheumaMIR comprises rheumatology-related MIR examination questions from 2009–2010 to 2022–2023, including those from overlapping specialties but excluding image-dependent questions [ 3 , 27 ] . Questions had five answer options until 2014–2015 and four from 2015–2016 onwards (Table S1 ). Each record includes the examination year, question type (clinical case or factual), patient sex, disease category, invalidation status, official answer, Spanish text and an English translation initially generated using DeepL. For this study, the dataset was consolidated into a single JSON file retaining each question’s pre-revision text. This expanded version is deposited in Zenodo alongside a report comparing each question with its pre-revision version [ 26 ] . Questions are identified by dataset ID (1–175).
blocks.zh: 来源. 瑞玛 MIR包括2009-2010年至2022-2023年与风湿病有关的MIR检查问题,包括来自重叠专业的问题,但不包括依赖图像的问题[3,27]. 问题在2014-2015年之前有五个答案选项,2015-2016年起有四个答案选项(表S1)。 每张记录包括考试年份,问题类型(临床病例或事实),病人性别,疾病类别,无效状态,官方答复,西班牙文文本以及最初使用DeepL生成的英文译本. 就这项研究而言,数据集被合并为一个JSON文件,保留每个问题的修改前文本。 该扩充版与一份报告一起存放在泽诺多,报告将每个问题与修订前版本作比较[26]。 问题通过数据集ID(1-175)识别。

blocks.en: Duplicate and invalidated records. The dataset contains 175 records, 145 records from the 2009–2010 to 2022–2023 examinations and 30 added from the 2023–2024 to 2025–2026. Records 120 and 140 duplicate questions 24 and 73, respectively; they were retained for traceability, marked as excluded and never sent to the models, leaving 173 evaluated questions. Question 111, a five-option clinical case from 2010–2011, is labelled invalidated but retains its legacy key (option 3). It was evaluated but excluded from all performance analyses, leaving 172 questions.
blocks.zh: 重复和无效的记录。 该数据集包含175个记录,145个记录来自2009–2010年到2022–2023年的考试,30个记录来自2023–2024年到2025–2026年的考试. 记录120和140分别重复了问题24和73;它们被保留以备追踪,标记为排除,从未送交模型,留下173个经过评价的问题。 问题111是2010-2011年的五种选择临床病例,被贴上无效的标签,但保留其遗留的关键(备选方案3)。 已对它进行了评价,但未列入所有业绩分析,留下172个问题。

blocks.en: Added questions. A rheumatologist (DB) selected 30 additional questions: 10 from 2023–2024 (MIR 2024), 11 from 2024–2025 (MIR 2025) and 9 from 2025–2026 (MIR 2026). Text was taken from version-0 examination booklets and keys from the Ministry of Health’s definitive answer keys. Two image-dependent questions were excluded.
blocks.zh: 添加问讯. 一名风湿病学家(DB)另选了30个问题:10个问题来自2023-2024年(MIR 2024年),11个问题来自2024-2025年(MIR 2025年),9个问题来自2025-2026年(MIR 2026年). 文本取自0版检查小册子和卫生部确定的答案钥匙。 排除了两个依赖形象的问题。

blocks.en: Reference-key issues. The reference answer of every question was the definitive key published by the Ministry of Health. Question 73 was not invalidated. Its excluded duplicate, record 140, carried an erroneous inherited invalidation label, which was corrected in the current dataset and preserved in the historical fields for traceability. Question 73 was included in the primary analysis; record 140 remained excluded as a duplicate. Question 93 (2011–2012, factual, five options) asks which method is most effective for preventing hip fracture (options: oestrogens; calcium and vitamin D; bisphosphonates; physical activity; calcitonin). Its inherited key is option 4, physical activity. Both GPT-6 Sol conditions, Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1 and Qwen3-8B selected option 3, bisphosphonates, in both languages, and Laya selected it in English (option 2 in Spanish). Clef selected the keyed option in both languages, as did Gemma 4 12B in run 1.
blocks.zh: 参考关键问题。 每个问题的参考答案是卫生部公布的确定的关键。 问题73没有作废。 它被排除的复制品,记录140,带有错误的继承无效标签,在目前的数据集中被更正,并保存在历史领域,以便追溯. 问题73已列入初步分析;记录140仍列为重复。 问题93(2011-2012年,事实,五种选择)询问哪种方法对防止臀部骨折最为有效(选择: o;钙和维生素D;双磷酸盐;体育活动;钙素)。 其继承的关键是选项4,体育活动。 GPT-6 Sol条件,Jev,GPT-6 Luna,Microsoft-Decision-1和Quen3-8B都选择了两种语言的选项3二磷酸盐,Laya选择了英语(西班牙语选项2). Clef选择了两种语言的按键选项,与运行1的Gemma 4 12B一样.

blocks.en: Translation and text revision. English text was revised for 129 of the 143 historical questions to correct mistranslations and omissions, clarify patient sex where stated in Spanish, and standardise terminology. In 10 questions, male wording was inferred from masculine Spanish grammar. Numbers, doses, units, option numbers and order were preserved, as were false statements in options. Spanish spelling, accent, punctuation and transcription errors were corrected (125 logged corrections across 72 questions), and final full stops were added to some options. The instruction “Justifique su respuesta” (“Justify your answer”), present in both languages in 144 of 145 historical questions and no new questions, was removed; it was misspelt “Jusitifique” in two Spanish stems. Revision in October 2026 included two complete reviews of all translations against the Spanish. The dataset retains every question’s pre-revision text, and the deposited comparison report documents all changes. Translations and Spanish text were reviewed using Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic; reasoning setting High) with the following verbatim prompt: “ Review all the questions in Spanish and their English translations. Check that each English translation accurately reflects the original meaning in Spanish, as it was generated automatically. Correct any translation, grammar, spelling, or wording errors, while preserving the original meaning as faithfully as possible. Also review the Spanish questions to identify and correct any typos, spelling mistakes, or grammatical errors .”. New questions were translated directly into English.
blocks.zh: 翻译和文本修订。 在143个历史问题中,有129个问题修改了英文文本,以纠正错误的翻译和遗漏,澄清西班牙语所述的病人性别,以及标准化术语。 在10个问题中,男性措辞是从男性西班牙语语法中推断出来的。 数字、剂量、单位、选项号和顺序得到保留,选项中的虚假陈述也是如此。 西班牙语拼写,重音,标音和抄写错误得到纠正(在72个问题中记录了125个更正),在一些选项中增加了最后全站. 145个历史问题中有144个以两种语文提出的“Justifique su respuesta”(“说明你的答案”)没有提出新的问题,但删除了该指示;该指示用两种西班牙语拼写为“Jusitifique”。 2026年10月的修订包括对照西班牙文对所有译文进行两次完整的审查。 数据集保留每个问题的修改前文本,交存的比较报告记录所有更改。 使用Claude Opus 5.5(Anthropic;推理设置高)对翻译和西班牙文本进行了审查,并逐字逐句:“审查所有西班牙语问题及其英文翻译。 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 每个英文译本准确反映西班牙语中的原意,因为它是自动生成的. 更正任何翻译,语法,拼写或措辞错误,同时尽可能忠实地保留原意. 还审查西班牙的问题,以查明和纠正任何打字、拼写错误或语法错误......”。 新问题已直接翻译成英文。

blocks.en: Labels. Question type and disease category were inherited from RheumaMIR and assigned to the added questions with the same criteria. The patient-sex label, not used in the analyses, was relabelled from male to not specified in questions 85 and 95, whose Spanish stems do not state it, and from “ does not apply ” to male in added question 172, a clinical case whose sex was inferred from masculine Spanish grammar.
blocks.zh: 标签。 问题类型和疾病类别从RheumaMIR中继承下来,并被分配到附加问题,标准相同. 分析中未使用的病人性别标签从男性重新标注到问题85和95中未具体说明,其西班牙语来源没有说明,从“不适用于”新增问题172中的男性,该临床病例的性别是从男性西班牙语语法推断出来的。

blocks.en: S1.2 RheumBench
blocks.zh: S1.2 莱姆奔驰

blocks.en: RheumBench comprises 100 cases, 70 diagnostic and 30 management, compiled by board-certified rheumatologists [ 4 ] . The diagnostic cases include 60 published case reports of rare rheumatic diseases and clinically important differential diagnoses, curated previously [ 28 ] , and 10 de-identified cases from University Hospital Hamburg, added to reduce training-data contamination risk. Two rheumatologists independently reviewed each case for completeness and quality and assessed its reference diagnosis for clinical plausibility. Each case includes patient age, sex, symptoms and available laboratory, examination and imaging findings. In the original benchmark, systems provided free-text answers, scored by a panel of LLM judges against case-specific rubrics. This study used only the 70 diagnostic cases, excluding management cases and rubrics and all collective diseases suggestions from the previously investigated LLMs. For 18/70 cases no correct diseases suggestion was initially proposed by the LLMs.
blocks.zh: Rheum Bench包括100个病例,70个诊断和30个管理,由董事会认证的风湿病学家汇编[4]. 诊断病例包括60例公布的罕见风湿病和临床上重要的差别诊断病例,此前已治愈[28],还有来自汉堡大学医院的10例已解析的病例,这些病例都是为了减少培训数据污染风险. 两名风湿病专家独立审查了每个病例的完整性和质量,并评估了临床可信性的参考诊断。 每个病例包括患者的年龄,性别,症状以及可用的实验室,检查和成像结果. 在最初的基准中,各系统提供了自由文本的答案,由LLM法官小组对照具体案件标题评分。 这项研究只利用了70个诊断案例,不包括管理案例和标题以及以前调查的法学硕士的所有集体疾病建议。 对于18/70个病例,最初没有提出正确的疾病建议。

blocks.en: The evaluation notebook generated two option sets. The listed set (primary) retains each case’s k candidate diagnoses, including cases without a correct option (n=18). The None of the above set (secondary) adds “ None of the above ” as option k + 1 to every case. This is correct for those 18 cases; answers for the remaining 52 are unchanged, giving all 70 cases a correct option.
blocks.zh: 评价笔记本产生了两套选项。 列出的一组(初级)保留了每个病例的K候选人诊断,包括没有正确选择的病例(n=18)。 上述各套(第二套)中,无一增加“上述任何一种......”作为每个案例的备选案文k+1。 这18个案例是正确的;其余52个案例的答案保持不变,使所有70个案例都有一个正确的选择。

blocks.en: Hardware and software. Local models ran on an Apple M1 Pro MacBook Pro with 16 GB of unified memory, with Python 3.13, Laya 0.3.20 and MLX-LM 0.32.0, whose server ran with the prompt cache disabled ( --prompt-cache-size 0 ), so that every request processed its full prompt.
blocks.zh: 硬件和软件。 本地型号运行在Apple M1 Pro MacBook Pro上,拥有16GB的统一内存,其中Python 3.13,Laya 0.3.20和MLX-LM 0.320.,其服务器运行的快速缓存已禁用(-prompt-cache-size 0 ),因此每个请求都会处理其全速.

blocks.en: S2.1 System One requests
blocks.zh: S2.1 系统 一个请求

blocks.en: RheumaMIR. The instruction was “Which option is the correct answer to this question?” in English and “¿Cuál es la respuesta correcta a esta pregunta?” in Spanish. Jev received each item as one request to the OpenRouter System One endpoint, with the stem as state and one choice question:
blocks.zh: 瑞玛米尔 该指示是“哪一个选择是这个问题的正确答案?” 英文是“Cuál es la respuesta rora a esta pregunta?” Jev作为一份请求收到OpenRouter系统一号端点,干子作为状态和一个选择问题:

blocks.en: {"model": "typesafe/jev-1.13", "state": "{stem}", "questions": {"answer": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "{instruction}", "criteria": {"1": "{option 1}", "2": "{option 2}", "3": "{option 3}", "4": "{option 4}"}}}}

Laya received the same state and question through its local package, with the language passed explicitly; with its default input limits, it shortened the options of two questions (three question–language pairs), and no stem or instruction was cut.
blocks.zh: Laya通过其本地软件包收到了同样的状态和问题,语言被明确传递;由于默认的输入限制,它缩短了两个问题(三个问题-语言对)的选项,没有剪干或指令。

blocks.en: GPT-6 Luna received the same question through the OpenAI Decisions API (public beta), with the stem as input and one choice per option, without a fallback choice. Clef and Microsoft-Decision-1 received the Jev request unchanged apart from the model identifier and a field pinning the provider (Cloudflare or Azure) through OpenRouter’s Decisions endpoint (alpha); every answer was served by the requested provider, and the longest input was well within the context limit of each model.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Luna通过OpenAI System API(公有β)收到了同样的问题,茎作为输入和每个选项一个选择,没有倒置选择. Clef和Microsoft-Decision-1收到Jev请求,除了模型标识符和通过OpenRouter的决定端点(alpha)给提供者(Cloudflare或Azure)钉上一个字段外,没有变化;每个答案都由请求的提供者提供,最长的输入完全在每一个模型的上下文限制范围内.

blocks.en: RheumBench. The requests had the same structure, with the instruction “Which option is the most likely diagnosis?”, the vignette as state (for GPT-6 Luna, as input) and the k candidate diagnoses, numbered 1 to k, as criteria (for GPT-6 Luna, as choices); in the None of the above set, option k + 1 was added. Laya’s English checkpoint shortened no option or instruction but cut the end of 10 vignettes (9 of the 52 analysed).
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-09-26). Rheum Bench. 请求的结构相同,说明“最有可能的诊断是哪一种选择?” , Vignette为状态(作为GPT-6 Luna,作为输入),K候选诊断为1至k,作为标准(作为GPT-6 Luna,作为选择);在上述组合中,没有一种选择为k+1。 Laya的英语检查站没有缩短任何选择或指示,而是缩短了10个葡萄酒的终点(在所分析的52个检查站中有9个)。

blocks.en: S2.2 Generative prompts and response validation
blocks.zh: S2.2 基因提示和反应验证

blocks.en: RheumaMIR. GPT-6 Sol received a single user message without a system prompt. English template (five-option questions add option 5 and refer to five probabilities):
blocks.zh: 瑞玛米尔 GPT-6 常规 Sol在没有系统提示的情况下收到单一用户消息. 英文模板(五个选项问题添加备选案文5并提及五个概率):

blocks.en: Which option is the correct answer to this question? Question: {stem} Options: 1. {option 1} 2. {option 2} 3. {option 3} 4. {option 4} Return the number of the correct answer in "answer" and, in "probabilities", your probability (between 0 and 1) that each option is the correct answer. The four probabilities must sum to 1.
blocks.zh: 这个问题的正确答案是什么? 问题 : {stem} 选项 : 1. {选项 1} 2. {选项 。 2} 3. {选项} 3} 4. {选项} 4} 在“ 答案” 中返回正确答案的号码, 在“ 概率” 中, 您的概率( 0 到 1 之间) 每个选项都是正确答案 。 四种概率必须等于 1.

blocks.en: Spanish template:
blocks.zh: 西班牙语模板 :

blocks.en: ¿Cuál es la respuesta correcta a esta pregunta? Pregunta: {stem} Opciones: 1. {option 1} 2. {option 2} 3. {option 3} 4. {option 4} Devuelve el número de la respuesta correcta en "answer" y, en "probabilities", tu probabilidad (entre 0 y 1) de que cada opción sea la respuesta correcta. Las cuatro probabilidades deben sumar 1.

blocks.en: For RheumBench, GPT-6 Sol received the following template (k is the number of options; with None of the above, it is the last option); the local generative models received the same message followed by the JSON format line described below:
blocks.zh: 用于Rheum Bench,GPT-6 索尔收到以下模板(k是选项数量;没有以上选项,它是最后一个选项);本地的基因模型收到相同的消息,然后是下文描述的JSON格式行:

blocks.en: Which option is the most likely diagnosis? Case: {vignette} Options: 1. {option 1} 2. {option 2} ... k. {option k} Return the number of the most likely diagnosis in "answer" and, in "probabilities", your probability (between 0 and 1) that each option is the correct diagnosis. The k probabilities must sum to 1.
blocks.zh: 哪种选择是最可能的诊断? 大小写 : {vignette} 选项: 1. {选项} 1 } 2. { 选项 2}... k. {选项 k} 在"答案"中返回最可能的诊断数,在"概率"中,返回你的概率(0到1之间),每个选项都是正确的诊断. k概率必须等于 1.

blocks.en: The strict JSON schema required an answer string from the available option numbers and a numerical probability for every available option. The local generative models received the same message followed by “Answer only with a JSON object in this format, with no other text:” (Spanish: “Responde únicamente con un objeto JSON con este formato, sin ningún otro texto:”) and a JSON example with the answer and all probability keys, because their server cannot enforce a schema.
blocks.zh: 严格的JSON schema需要从可用的选项数字中获取一个答案字符串,以及每个可用的选项的数值概率. 当地基因模型收到同样的信息,然后是“只用这种格式的JSON对象回答,没有其他文字:” (西班牙语:“Responde únicamente con un objeto JSON con este formato, sin ningún otro texto :”)和带有答案和所有概率键的JSON实例,因为他们的服务器无法执行一个计划.

blocks.en: Retries and output limits. Unsuccessful requests were attempted up to three times. Every request ultimately returned a valid answer, 23 after a second attempt (17 in RheumaMIR and 6 in RheumBench). For the local generative models, the parser read the first JSON object in each response, after removing any thinking text (present in four Gemma 4 12B RheumaMIR responses, two of them in run 1, although thinking was disabled; removing it did not change their answers), and required an available answer and finite, non-negative probabilities with a positive total. Probabilities written for options that had not been offered (nine Gemma 4 12B responses, two in RheumaMIR and seven in RheumBench; non-zero, 0.01, in two RheumBench responses from runs 2 and 3 of cases without the reference diagnosis) were discarded before rescaling; the returned answer was not affected, and no run-1 estimate changed.
blocks.zh: 检索和输出限制。 三次试图提出未获成功的请求。 每一份请求最终都回复了有效的答案,在第二次尝试(RheumaMIR17次,Rheum Bench6次)后有23次. 在本地基因模型中,解析器在删除任何思维文本(在四个Gemma 4 12B RheumaMIR响应中出现,其中两个在运行1中,虽然思维被禁用;去除它并没有改变他们的答案)后,在每个响应中读作第一个JSON对象,需要有一个可用的答案和有限制的,非负概率的,有正总的概率. 未提供的选项(9个Gemma 4 12B回复,2个在RheumaMIR回复,7个在Rheum Bench回复;2个Rheum Bench回复,2个没有参考诊断的病例中的Rheum Bench回复,0.01)的概率在复标前被丢弃;返回的答案没有受到影响,1运行估计没有改变.

blocks.en: Probability vectors. Native probabilities were analysed as returned; Jev’s are rounded to two decimals, so 6 of its 1,038 RheumaMIR vectors summed to 0.99. Stated vectors that did not sum to 1 ( ± \pm 0.01) occurred in 43 of 1,038 Gemma 4 12B and 23 of 1,038 Qwen3-8B responses; all stated vectors were rescaled to sum to 1 over the offered options. The selected option had a lower probability than another option in one Jev response and 80 Qwen3-8B responses across the three runs, and the selected option shared the highest probability with another option in three Microsoft-Decision-1, two Jev, four Gemma 4 12B and 38 Qwen3-8B responses; the returned answer was always scored.
blocks.zh: 概率矢量. 原生概率被分析为返回;Jev的概率被四舍五入到两个小数,因此其1,038 RheumaMIR 矢量中的6个总和为0.99. 在1 038 Gemma 4 12B和1 038 Qune3-8B的答复中,43个报告向量与1(±\pm 0.01)相加,23个报告向量与1(Qwen3-8B)相加;所有报告向量均调整为1,高于所提供选项。 所选选项在一个Jev响应中概率低于另一个选项,在三个运行中共有80个Qwen3-8B响应,所选选项在3个Microsoft-Decision-1,2个Jev,4个Gemma 4个12B和38个Qwen3-8B响应中与另一个选项共享最高概率;返回的答案总是得分.

blocks.en: In RheumBench (listed option set; 210 responses per model, 70 cases in three runs), all native probability vectors returned by the System One models and GPT-6 Luna summed to 1 within 0.01 (Jev 0.99–1.00). Stated vectors that did not sum to 1 ( ± \pm 0.01) occurred in 120 of 210 Gemma 4 12B responses, 164 of 210 Qwen3-8B responses, 4 of 210 GPT-6 Sol responses without reasoning and none with medium reasoning; they were rescaled as above. The selected option had a lower probability than another option in one Jev response and two Qwen3-8B responses, and shared the highest probability with another option in two Microsoft-Decision-1 responses, one Gemma 4 12B response and two Qwen3-8B responses; the returned answer was always scored.
blocks.zh: 在Rheum Bench(列表选项集;每个模型210个响应,每3个运行中70个案例)中,所有原生概率矢量都由系统一模型返回,GPT-6 Luna在0.01内汇总为1个(Jev 0.99–1.00. 210 Gemma 4 12B答复中的120个、210 Qune3-8B答复中的164个、210 GPT-6答复中的4个。 解答无推理,无中推理;它们被调整为以上. 所选选项在一个Jev响应和两个Qwen3-8B响应中的概率低于另一个选项,并在两个Microsoft-Decision-1响应,一个Gemma 4 12B响应和两个Quen3-8B响应中与另一个选项共享最高概率;返回的答案总是得分.

blocks.en: S3 Statistical methods and paired comparisons
blocks.zh: S3 统计方法和配对比较

blocks.en: Wilson intervals describe single proportions. Exact McNemar tests use only the questions answered correctly by one of the two conditions being compared. Two thousand bootstrap resamples of question identifiers, generated with NumPy seed 2026, provide percentile intervals for paired differences and AUROC; each resample keeps languages and models paired. Holm adjustment was applied to the ten comparisons of System One models with GPT-6 Sol (medium) and, separately, to the five System One language comparisons. The secondary comparators were described without significance tests.
blocks.zh: 威尔逊间隔描述单比例. 精确的McNemar测试只使用被比较的两个条件之一正确回答的问题. 由NumPy种子2026生成的两千个问题识别符的靴子复标,为配对差异和AUROC提供了百分位间隔;每个复标保留语言和模型配对. Holm调整适用于System One模型与GPT-6 Sol(中型)的十种比较,并分别适用于System One语言的五种比较. 次要参照国的描述没有意义。

blocks.en: In RheumBench, the same methods were applied to the 52 cases with the reference diagnosis among the options, with bootstrap resamples of cases. Holm adjustment was applied to the five comparisons of System One models with GPT-6 Sol (medium) for accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在Rheum Bench案中,对52个案例采用了同样的方法,在各种选择中进行了参考诊断,并增加了病例的复标。 霍尔姆调整适用于系统一模型与GPT-6 Sol(中等)的五种比较,以求准确.

blocks.en: Errors in RheumaMIR. GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning answered 11 of Jev’s 12 Spanish errors and 13 of its 14 English errors correctly, and all of Clef’s errors (Table S3 ). Jev shared 4 of Clef’s 14 Spanish errors and 5 of its 12 English errors, so the two models failed largely on different questions, and GPT-6 Luna’s three errors in each language other than question 93 differed from Jev’s. GPT-6 Sol’s only discordance with the answer key in run 1, in both conditions and languages, was question 93 (2011–2012) on hip-fracture prevention: GPT-6 Sol, Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1 and Qwen3-8B selected bisphosphonates (Laya in English only), whereas Clef selected the keyed answer, physical activity (Section S1.1 ); in run 3, GPT-6 Sol without reasoning also missed question 14 in Spanish. A negatively worded question on temporal arteritis was a confident error (selected-answer probability 0.90–0.98) of Jev, Clef and Microsoft-Decision-1 in both languages (question 33; Table S8 ); with question 93, it accounted for the two errors among Jev’s answers retained at the 0.90 threshold in each language.
blocks.zh: RheumaMIR. GPT-6中的错误 以中度推理解答Jev的12个西班牙错误和14个英语错误中的13个正确答案,以及克莱夫的所有错误(表S3). Jev分享了克莱夫14个西班牙语错误中的4个和12个英语错误中的5个,因此这两个模型在不同的问题上基本上失败了,GPT-6 Luna除了问题93之外,每种语言的3个错误与Jev不同. GPT-6 Sol在运行1中唯一与答案键的不和,在条件和语言上都是关于臀部骨折预防的问题93(2011-2012年):GPT-6 Sol, Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Microsoft-Decision-1和Qune3-8B选择了双磷酸盐(只有英语),而Clef选择了按键答案,身体活动(S1.1节);在运行3中,没有推理的GPT-6 Sol也错过了西班牙语中的问题14. 关于时间性关节炎的负面措辞问题是Jev、Clef和Microsoft-Decision-1在两种语言(问题33;表S8)中的一种自信错误(选择答案概率为0.90-0.98);在问题93中,它说明了Jev在每种语言0.90阈值中保留的答复中的两个错误。

blocks.en: S4 Probability results and sensitivity analyses
blocks.zh: S4 概率结果和敏感性分析

blocks.en: Probability analyses use selected-answer probabilities, rather than the separate confidence values returned by Jev, GPT-6 Luna, Clef and Microsoft-Decision-1. The over/underconfidence index is the mean selected-answer probability minus accuracy; positive values indicate overconfidence. Expected calibration error (ECE) is the weighted mean absolute difference between mean probability and accuracy across equal-width bins closed on the right, with a probability of 0 in the first bin; ten-bin estimates are descriptive and bin-dependent. The convention matters because Jev, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol and the local generative models often give probabilities that lie exactly on a bin edge. Correctness AUROC measures whether correct answers receive higher selected-answer probabilities than incorrect answers and is reported only when at least five answers are correct and five incorrect. Correctness AUROC values are given in Table S4 , and reliability diagrams for the local generative models in Figure S1 .
blocks.zh: 概率分析使用选定的答案概率,而不是Jev,GPT-6 Luna,Clef和Microsoft-Decision-1分别返回的置信值. 过度/不信任指数是平均选择的答案概率减去准确性;正值表示过度自信. 预期校准误差(ECE)是右侧关闭的等宽箱的平均概率和精度之间的加权平均绝对差,第一个箱的概率为0;十元箱的估计数是描述性的和bin依赖的. 公约之所以重要,是因为Jev,GPT-6 Luna,GPT-6 Sol以及当地基因模型往往给出了完全位于宾边的概率. 正确性 AUROC 测量正确答案是否得到比错误答案更高的选择性答案概率,只有在至少5个答案正确和5个不正确时才会报告. 表S4给出了AUROC值,图S1给出了当地基因模型的可靠性图。

blocks.en: Sensitivity analyses. Scoring the highest-probability option instead of the returned answer (retaining the latter when tied for highest probability) changed accuracy by at most one question or case in every condition except Qwen3-8B on RheumaMIR. Its returned answer differed from its highest-probability option in 80 of 1,038 responses; accuracy fell from 64.0% to 59.3% in Spanish and from 68.0% to 65.1% in English. Laya truncated 9 of the 52 analysed RheumBench vignettes, answering none correctly (random guessing: 9.0%). It correctly answered 5 of the 43 complete vignettes (11.6%, 95% CI 5.1–24.5; random guessing: 9.8%).
blocks.zh: 敏感性分析。 在RheumaMIR上的Qwen3-8B之外,对最高概率选项而不是对返回的答案进行校准(在绑定最高概率时保留后者),在每一个条件中最多都会改变一个问题或案例的准确性. 在1 038份答复中,80份答复的回执与其最高概率不同;西班牙语的准确度从64.0%降至59.3%,英语的准确度从68.0%降至65.1%。 52个被分析的Rheum Bench vignettes中, 它正确回答了43个完整阴茎中的5个(11.6%,95%CI 5.1-24.5;随机猜测:9.8%)。

blocks.en: Additional probability results. In RheumaMIR, 10 of Jev’s 12 Spanish errors and 12 of its 14 English errors had selected-answer probabilities below 0.9; retained errors had probabilities of 0.90–0.96 (Section S3 ). GPT-6 Luna’s probabilities underestimated accuracy (ECE 0.049 and 0.062), so the 0.90 threshold deferred 37 Spanish and 45 English answers, including only three and four errors, respectively. Four errors per language were insufficient to assess discrimination. GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning assigned its sole discordant answer a probability below 0.9. At this threshold, Clef retained 129 Spanish (75.0%) and 137 English (79.7%) answers; Microsoft-Decision-1 retained 150 (87.2%) and 138 (80.2%), respectively (ECE 0.088 and 0.073); and Gemma 4 12B retained 81 (47.1%) and 83 (48.3%), with accuracies of 85.2% and 84.3% (Table 2 of the main text). In RheumBench, ECE was 0.113 for GPT-6 Luna and 0.074 for GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning. Microsoft-Decision-1 discriminated correct from incorrect answers (AUROC 0.811) despite marked overconfidence (ECE 0.331). Laya’s mean selected-answer probability was 0.716, compared with 9.6% accuracy (ECE 0.646). Qwen3-8B’s stated probabilities did not always agree with its selected answer (Section S2 ).
blocks.zh: 额外概率结果。 在RheumaMIR案中,Jev的12个西班牙错误中的10个和14个英文错误中的12个选择答案概率低于0.9;保留错误的概率为0.90-0.96(S3节)。 GPT-6 Luna的概率低估了准确性(ECE 0.049和0.062),因此0.90阈值推迟了37个西班牙语和45个英语答案,分别包括3个和4个错误. 每个语言有四个错误不足以评估歧视。 具有中等推理的GPT-6 Sol指定其唯一不协调者回答概率低于0.9. 在这个门槛值上,克莱夫保留了129个西班牙语(75.0%)和137个英语(79.7%)的回答;Microsoft-Decision-1分别保留了150个(87.2%)和138个(80.2%)(ECE 0.088和0.073);Gemma 4 12 B保留了81个(47.1%)和83个(48.3%),其速率分别为85.2%和84.3%(正文表2)。 在Rheum Bench中,ECE为0.113GPT-6 Luna,0.074为GPT-6 Sol,具有中度推理. Microsoft-Decision-1对错误的回答(AUROC 0.811)作了正确的区分,尽管有明显的过度自信(ECE 0.331)。 Laya的平均选择答案概率为0.716,而准确度为9.6%(ECE 0.646)。 Qune3-8B所说的概率并不总是同意其选定的答案(S2节)。

blocks.en: S5 Repeatability, latency and cost
blocks.zh: S5 重复性、延迟性和费用

blocks.en: In RheumaMIR, GPT-6 Luna, Clef, Laya and GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning gave the same answer to every analysed question in all three runs (GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning changed only its answer to invalidated question 111), and GPT-6 Luna and Clef also returned identical probabilities; Jev changed its answer in five question–language pairs (three Spanish, two English) and Microsoft-Decision-1 in six (four Spanish, two English). In RheumBench, Jev changed its answer in 2 of the 52 cases, Microsoft-Decision-1 in 3 within two minutes, GPT-6 Sol in 4 (no reasoning) and 6 (medium reasoning), Qwen3-8B in 5 and Gemma 4 12B in 26 (Table S5 ); over all 70 cases, including the 18 without the reference diagnosis, the corresponding numbers were 4, 4, 5, 12, 10 and 37. Jev’s median latency was four to six times lower than that of GPT-6 Sol in RheumaMIR and 16 times lower than that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning in RheumBench, and its cost 48–77 and 181 times lower. Locally, Laya answered in 0.04–0.11 s, Qwen3-8B in 3.1–7.0 s and Gemma 4 12B in 5.7–39.9 s (Table S6 ).

blocks.en: In the 18 cases whose reference diagnosis was absent from the options, no answer could be scored as correct (Table S7 ). Including forced answers retained at the 0.90 threshold, accuracy of retained answers fell to 91.3% for GPT-6 Luna (21/23, from 95.5%) and 78.6% for Jev (11/14, from 84.6%). When “None of the above” was added, GPT-6 Luna selected it in 4 of these 18 cases and none of the 52 with a correct listed option; Microsoft-Decision-1 selected it in 3 and 2, respectively, and Laya in 9 and 32. No other model selected it in any of the 18 cases. Across all 70 cases, accuracy was 61.4% for GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning, 51.4% for GPT-6 Luna, 42.9% for Clef, 35.7% for Jev and 34.3% for Microsoft-Decision-1. Among the locally run models, it ranged from 14.3% (Laya) to 27.1% (Gemma 4 12B). Adding None of the above also changed some answers in the 52 cases with a correct listed option. GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning answered 43 of them correctly, against 40 with the listed options.

blocks.en: Code and data. For each benchmark, an evaluation notebook sends the requests and saves every request and response, and an analysis notebook computes the reported tables and figures from the saved responses without calling any model or requiring credentials. All scores, extracted answers and probability vectors were checked against the raw responses, and the content of every request against the dataset files. The dataset, the code and the results for RheumaMIR are attached as SM_code_dataset_statistics. The RheumBench vignettes belong to the RheumBench study. The dataset, the code and the results for RheumBench will be made available by JK upon reasonable request.
